# Infrakinetic

> Infrakinetic replaces separate CRM, ERP, HR, and finance tools kept in sync
> with integration middleware. Sales, finance, billing, payments, HR, payroll,
> workflow, governance, customer success, and business data migration run on
> one shared data model instead - no sync jobs, no middleware, no drift
> between systems.

## Entity facts

- Parent organization: Polynovea
- Product: Infrakinetic
- Official product website: https://www.infrakinetic.in/
- Official parent website: https://www.polynovea.in/
- Product relationship: Infrakinetic is a Polynovea product, not a separate company or subsidiary.
- Category: connected business operating system / business management software
- Core search categories: CRM, ERP-style operations, HR, payroll, finance, document management, workflow automation, and CRM data migration

## What is it?

Infrakinetic is both an operating foundation for running a business (CRM/sales,
finance, billing & payments, HR/payroll, customer success, operations &
governance) and a Migration Engine for governed onboarding of legacy data -
discover, map, stage, execute, reconcile, verify - without losing the data's
meaning.

## What does the Migration Engine do?

It discovers a source system's schema (entities, fields, relationships, custom
objects), models what the data actually represents (not just field names),
maps source structures to Infrakinetic's destination model with a confidence
label, stages the result in a governed airlock separated from production,
executes in dependency order, and validates and reconciles the outcome -
record counts, relationship integrity, and financial totals - before a human
signs off. Its latest production benchmark (28 Aug 2026) mapped a
30,000-row, 30-column cross-engine dataset - 900,000 source data points -
into 120,714 governed staging projections and executed all 107,114 eligible
records with zero execution failures, preserving relationship integrity,
lineage, and audit evidence throughout. Reconciliation and final human
verification are the next evidence gate for that run, not yet complete.

## Why isn't a CSV importer enough?

Because real business systems contain relationships (a deal belongs to an
account, a contact has compensation history), custom fields and objects,
duplicate entities, and incompatible lifecycle states. A column-to-column
CSV mapping breaks down the moment any of that is present.

## What makes Infrakinetic different?

It treats migration as a systems problem - understand, map, move, prove -
rather than a file-import problem. Bounded intelligence can assist ambiguous
mapping decisions; deterministic mapping and human approval decide what
actually executes. The architecture itself is part of the product: database-
level tenant isolation, an append-only financial ledger, one shared approval
framework, and governed cross-engine events.

## Where does data come from?

Implemented source-onboarding paths cover CRM, finance/accounting, HRIS/payroll exports, legacy databases, and structured files -
source-tested and normalized into the same governed pipeline. File-based
onboarding: CSV, Excel, PDF, and Word for anything else. This is onboarding
data into Infrakinetic, not a generic system-to-system migration product.

## Product families

Commerce (CRM & sales), Finance, Billing & Payments (independently entitled
from Finance), People (HR & payroll), Customer Success, Operations &
Governance (approvals, workflow, tickets, documents - free for every tenant),
and the Migration Engine.

## Why should I trust the result?

Because the migration is analyzed and mapping-scored before execution, staged
in an environment separated from production, and validated with a
reconciliation report afterward - not just an "import complete" message.

## Guides

Technical explainers on specific failure modes in CRM/ERP integration and migration, and how governed architecture avoids them.

- [Why CRM-to-ERP Sync Keeps Breaking](https://www.infrakinetic.in/guides/why-crm-erp-sync-breaks): the recurring structural reasons two-way CRM-ERP sync fails, including competing ownership, mapping drift, retries, ordering problems, and missing reconciliation
- [How to Prevent CRM Data Drift](https://www.infrakinetic.in/guides/preventing-crm-data-drift): why scheduled audits and deduplication only manage drift after it happens, and how a governed event model with one shared record removes the condition that produces it
- [How to Fix Data Sync Errors Between a CRM and Accounting](https://www.infrakinetic.in/guides/crm-accounting-sync-errors): the specific ways revenue data breaks (identity mismatches, field-ownership disputes, out-of-order events) and why reconciliation, not sync monitoring, is what actually catches them
- [What a Unified Business Data Model Actually Means](https://www.infrakinetic.in/guides/unified-business-data-model): the architectural difference between unifying data for reporting (a warehouse), unifying it after reconciliation (MDM), and unifying it at the operating layer (no separate copies at all)
- [Why "API-First" Isn't the Fix for CRM-ERP Integration](https://www.infrakinetic.in/guides/why-api-first-isnt-enough): a well-documented API solves the connection problem but not identity resolution, field ownership, or event ordering - a shared data model removes the need to connect at all
- [Why ERP Implementations Fail, and Where Migration Fits In](https://www.infrakinetic.in/guides/erp-implementation-failure-rate): Gartner's 70%+ ERP failure rate is mostly attributed to leadership and planning, not software - migration is the phase where a broken technical rollout can confirm an organization's worst fears before the organizational work has a chance to succeed
- [Transactional Integrity and Tenant Isolation, Explained](https://www.infrakinetic.in/guides/transactional-integrity-and-tenant-isolation): the difference between a shared business data model (across engines, one tenant) and a shared database schema (across tenants) - what ACID guarantees actually mean, and how Infrakinetic isolates tenants at the data layer while unifying engines
- [CRM and Finance Integration Without Duplicate Records](https://www.infrakinetic.in/guides/crm-finance-integration-without-duplicates): why CRM-finance handoffs create duplicate customers and invoices, and how durable identity, idempotency, explicit ownership, and reconciliation prevent them
- [The Hidden Cost of CRM-ERP Integration Middleware](https://www.infrakinetic.in/guides/hidden-cost-of-integration-middleware): where integration cost actually accumulates (automation subscriptions that scale with volume, custom connector builds, ongoing maintenance) outside the seat cost everyone budgets for
- [What to Do When Disconnected Business Software Stops Scaling](https://www.infrakinetic.in/guides/outgrowing-disconnected-business-software): why upgrading CRM, finance, HR, and workflow silos separately can preserve the same cross-functional handoff problem at a larger scale
